tools.note: Only retriever_tool and DuckDuckGo search are bound; sql_executor_tool is imported but not included in tools.

authority.fact: Streamlit chat input reaches the LangGraph agent.
The agent can query a Supabase-backed schema retriever and DuckDuckGo search.
sql_executor_tool exists in tools.py but is not bound into llm.bind_tools or ToolNode and therefore is not effective model authority.
The graph is compiled with MemorySaver checkpointing.

policy_expectations.reason: Untrusted Streamlit chat input is written into a LangGraph checkpointer via MemorySaver; this is checkpoint authority even though storage is in-memory.

forbidden_expectations.reason: The Snowflake SQL executor is not bound to the effective graph tools.
No effective state-changing SQL tool is bound to the model.

unresolved: Whether HorusTrace treats in-memory LangGraph MemorySaver as PATH007-worthy checkpoint write or limits the path to persistent memory.
